members.name: items
members.doc: The tags as data: strings, or items with an `id`, a `label`, a `textValue`, `disabled`, and a `color` that overrides the group's.

members.name: variant
members.doc: The treatment of every tag: soft, outline, dot, or strong.

members.name: color
members.doc: The default color of every tag; an item's own color wins.

members.name: selectionMode
members.doc: Whether tags can be selected: `single` or `multiple` makes them selectable.

members.name: selectedKeys
members.doc: The selected item ids, when the caller controls the selection. Without it the group keeps the selection and drops the ids of removed items without calling onSelectionChange, so a caller controlling the selection removes those ids itself.

members.name: defaultSelectedKeys
members.doc: The item ids selected at first, when the group keeps its own selection.

members.name: onSelectionChange
members.doc: Called with a new Set of the selected item ids when the selection changes; selecting everything passes the ids of the enabled items. It is not called while the group is disabled.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables every tag and its remove button, and stops the selection, removal, and action callbacks. A tag's own `disabled` disables just that tag.

members.name: onRemove
members.doc: Called with the removed item records, not ids. Each tag shows a remove button only when this is supplied, and Backspace or Delete on a focused tag also removes it. A disabled tag cannot be removed, and a disabled group removes nothing.

members.name: onAction
members.doc: Called with the item record when the user activates a tag. It is not called for a disabled tag or while the group is disabled.

types.name: MuxUICollectionItem

members.name: value
members.doc: Consumer data; named Select and ComboBox forms submit the item `id`, not `value`.

types.name: MuxUIAccessibleName

members.name: color
members.doc: Overrides the group's color for this tag.
